name: Phở Lá Xanh
description: A fresh, herb-green theme for Vietnamese canteens and phở shops: gạch bông tile patterns, a menu board of phở, bánh mì and rice plates drawn bowl by bowl, a build-your-bowl guide with an interactive herb plate, open-now status, location and a Jamstacks contact component for catering trays, group lunches and allergen questions.
